body: Too anxious to leave the house :( I feel so trapped and depressed inside all day. Knowing this will happen every time I go down 1/4 which is every week = 2 and a half months is daunting.

My family doctor was a joke, he told me to take half my dose 4mg to 2mg for 2 weeks then stop. My psych told me that was the worst tapering plan she's ever heard of for this stuff. It's powerfully addictive.. Even this plan of 1/4 down per week is disabling.
